changes.title: Afterparty sound
items: When the party's over the music winds down like a record stopping, and each area has its own quiet night: wind in the pines, frogs in the bogs, owls and crickets in the woods, the sea at home
Sleeping animals snore softly near you

changes.title: Beach witches always
items: There are always witches on the beach now: a handful of them, each on her own, spread all the way round the island's coast
Lie down to stargaze on the beach and the world curves away so the whole night sky opens up over the sea
Stargaze together with a beach witch for a few seconds and little hearts float up off you both
Invitations that land on the beach or in the sea stay longer and fade slowly, bobbing on the water

changes.title: Spell scroll
items: The party spell is a scroll: bottom right of the dressing-up screen, an open scroll with 🎶 on it. Go near it and it glows, ripples and trembles as the room darkens; click it and it grows, crackles and bursts, and the party begins
The dressing-up panel sits on the left now, with her room beside it
